description: For open analytics questions such as "what drives revenue?", "what is related to churn time?" or "which factors matter for score?": ranks every other column (or the ones given) by how strongly it relates to a numeric target column. Pearson r for numeric columns, correlation ratio η plus the highest/lowest group for categorical ones. Descriptive (no p-values); follow up on the top findings with group_summary, correlation, charts or a hypothesis test. Works on files of any size. Use it in an explore analysis. The user confirms the target and the columns first.

confirmation_token.description: Only after the user has confirmed: the confirmation_token from the previous response.

file.description: The data file the user named or attached (path or name; never its contents).

target.description: The numeric outcome to explain, e.g. Revenue.

name: find_relationships
title: What relates to a column
